parameters.jsCode: const q=$('Webhook').first().json.query||{};const zone='Europe/Rome';let to=q.to?DateTime.fromISO(q.to,{zone}):DateTime.now().setZone(zone);let from=q.from?DateTime.fromISO(q.from,{zone}):to.minus({days:6});let error=null;if(!from.isValid||!to.isValid)error='Date non valide';if(!error&&from>to)error='La data iniziale è successiva alla finale';const days=!error?Math.floor(to.startOf('day').diff(from.startOf('day'),'days').days)+1:0;if(!error&&days>90)error='Range massimo: 90 giorni';return [{json:{valid:!error,error,from_local:from.toISODate(),to_local:to.toISODate(),from_utc:from.startOf('day').toUTC().toISO(),to_utc:to.endOf('day').toUTC().toISO(),days}}];
